t: What following a funeral through is worth
a: مَنِ اتَّبَعَ جَنَازَةَ مُسْلِمٍ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا، وَكَانَ مَعَهُ حَتَّى يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا، وَيَفْرُغَ مِنْ دَفْنِهَا، فَإِنَّهُ يَرْجِعُ مِنَ الأَجْرِ بِقِيرَاطَيْنِ
p: Mani-ttabaʿa janāzata muslimin īmānan wa-ḥtisāban, wa kāna maʿahu ḥattā yuṣallā ʿalayhā wa yafrugha min dafnihā, fa-innahu yarjiʿu mina-l-ajri bi-qīrāṭayn
m: Whoever follows a Muslim's funeral out of faith and seeking the reward, and stays with it until the prayer is done and the burial is finished, comes back with two carats of reward.
